body: Start a timer on a client's project, see the week's entries, and turn a client's hours into an invoice (export to PDF; it can be redone, and nothing is sent).
Used all day: timers are started and stopped many times a day; invoices go out weekly or monthly.
Plum on near-black, chalk as the second colour. The logo is a tally of four strokes crossed by a fifth.
Two screens: the week, and an invoice draft for one client.

body: For people who read a lot of mail and answer some of it. Open for hours in a full tab, often large, but it must work at 80×24. Long messages, and wide lines in them.
Mail syncs every minute in the background and can fail while offline. Mouse on. A sent message can be undone for 5 seconds.
Soft rose on midnight blue, slate as the second colour. The logo is a round burrow door with a warm light inside.
Two screens: the inbox (the list, and reading a message), and compose.

body: Network, storage, backups, users and updates: about 60 settings in six sections, findable by name. Changes stay pending until applied together.
Applying takes 3 to 10 seconds and can partly fail. Some changes restart a service; one, the admin port, can lock you out.
Used a few times a month, over SSH, for 5 to 15 minutes. Sage on near-black, bone as the second colour. The logo is a small nest with one egg.
Two screens: settings, and review & apply.
